clips.title: The story
paras: The Spectral Comb is an ethereal grooming tool used to interact with the restless dead of Duskwood. Fashioned to pass through intangible forms, it is brought to the sorrowful spirit Blind Mary to harvest strands of ghost hair.

Normal implements cannot touch or groom a spirit, making gathering ethereal materials nearly impossible for mortal craftsmen. The Spectral Comb is specially suited to interact with ghostly forms, gliding through otherwise intangible tresses. It is carried south of Darkshire to the ruined farmstead where the weeping ghost Blind Mary wails in isolation. Finding solace in the familiar act of grooming her ruined hair, Mary willingly uses the comb, leaving behind the spectral fibers needed to weave Ghost Hair Thread.
